caption: Back exercises at home no equipment: the doorframe row ladder, four rungs from a lean to a single arm row. The missing half of home strength. Save the ladder.

voiceover.text: Home workouts train half your body. The front half.
Nothing to pull, so nobody pulls. Except you have doorframes.
Here is the ladder nobody does at home.
Rung one. Hold the frame. Lean back. Row in. Ten.
Rung two. Feet closer, deeper lean. Eight rows.
Rung three. Sit right into it. Full range. Eight.
Rung four. One arm. Six rows a side.
When a rung feels easy, climb.
This is the missing half of your strength.
Your front pushed for years. Your back just answered.
You just turned a doorway into a back machine.
Every door in your home is equipment now. Yours.
Tomorrow, five moves that make zero noise.
Which rung will you start on?

overlays.text: Home training skips your back. Not today.
Rung one. Lean back and row in.
Rung two. Deeper lean, eight rows.
Rung three. Full range rows, eight.
Rung four. One arm, six each side.
When a rung feels easy, climb.
Which rung will you start on?
